samples.input: A scheduling system has tasks with durations and precedence constraints. Explain how you would detect impossible cycles before optimizing total time.
samples.target: Represent dependencies as a directed graph and run cycle detection/topological sort. If a directed cycle exists, the precedence system is infeasible and optimization should stop before makespan search.

samples.input: You must choose one sensor query to distinguish between two competing fault models. Model A predicts pressure high/temperature normal; Model B predicts pressure normal/temperature high. Which query has highest information value?
samples.target: Either pressure or temperature alone separates the models if measurements are reliable. Prefer the measurement with lower noise/cost; if equal, both have equal discriminating value.
